## 2.5.1: no more black screen

Some people saw a pitch-black window after installing 2.4 or 2.5. This release makes sure that can't happen silently, and fixes it by itself in the most common cases:

- **Safe graphics.** If a start doesn't finish loading, the next start draws without GPU acceleration (some graphics drivers show a black window with it on). It stays on once it works. Switch it under Settings → UPDATES → GRAPHICS. You can also start the launcher with `--safe-graphics`.
- **No more silent black screen.** If something fails while starting, the launcher shows what went wrong (with a CONTINUE ANYWAY button) instead of a black window. If the screen doesn't load after 25 seconds, it offers to restart in safe graphics.
- **Log file.** Problems are written to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\SkyvaintGameLauncher\logs\launcher.log`. If you still get a black screen, please send that file (Settings → UPDATES → OPEN LOG).
- Each part of the start-up (game scan, Steam, Epic, Roblox) now runs on its own, so one failing on your PC doesn't stop the rest.
- Setup screen: shows "FIRST START" on the first start, as intended.

## Install

Download `SkyvaintGameLauncher-win-x64.zip`, unzip it anywhere and run `SkyvaintGameLauncher.exe`. Already on 2.5.0? Settings → UPDATES → UPDATE NOW. Your settings are kept.
